title: Universal virtual braid groups
summary: We introduce the universal virtual braid group $UV_n(c)$, which provides a unified algebraic framework for virtual braid--type structures with $c$ types of crossings and admits natural quotient maps onto the standard families in the literature. We prove that $UV_n(c)$ contains a right-angled Artin subgroup of finite index, yielding strong structural consequences: residual finiteness, linearity, solvability of the word and conjugacy problems, and the Tits alternative.
